steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v4
Run actions/setup-java@v4
Cache Godot and export templates
Download Godot 4.7.1
Import project
Test – full race against the AI
Test – championship over all tracks
Test – time trial against the ghost
Test – shortcuts (worth it only with a turbo or the star, laps counted right)
Test – computer drivers on every track (Hard, no item boxes)
Test – new items (blue missile, oil, lightning, shield)
Test – take-offs only from the ramp (turbo and star, all tracks)
Test – take-offs only from the ramp on the mirrored tracks
Test – unlocks (made-up cups and time trials, paints, secret driver, mirrored tracks, developer's ghost)
Test – steering by tilting the phone (made-up sensor readings, levelling at the start)
Test – vibrations (every event, never more than 10 a second, nothing when off; also for two players)
Test – music (both tracks load and loop, menu / race / pause / end)
Test – balloon battle (the rules, then both arenas on every difficulty with only the computer driving)
Test – Wi-Fi game on a mirrored track with 120 ms delay each way, every item in turn, everybody on the shortcut, gold paint
Test – balloon battle over Wi-Fi with 120 ms delay each way (the client sees the host's battle, a third player leaves in the middle)
Test – finding games on the network
Test – a different game version is refused
Export Windows EXE
Export Android APK
Show results
Run actions/upload-artifact@v4
Publish test build (release "testovaci-build")
Post Cache Godot and export templates
Post Run actions/setup-java@v4
Post Run actions/checkout@v4
Complete job
